description: Civgraph semantic graph property registry. The first production slice keeps these properties deliberately small and stable.

properties.label: instance of
properties.description: Links an entity to its Civgraph entity type.

properties.label: name
properties.description: Human-readable name for an entity.

properties.label: elected body
properties.description: The elected body connected to a person, office, election, or register record.

properties.label: political office
properties.description: The office connected to a politician or register record.

properties.label: member of political party or label
properties.description: A party or electoral label associated with a person in the source data.

properties.label: stood in election
properties.description: An election appearance for a person.

properties.label: has contest
properties.description: An election contains a constituency, ward, DEA, or other result unit.

properties.label: contest in election
properties.description: The parent election for an election contest.

properties.label: has candidature
properties.description: A person's candidature or appearance in an election contest.

properties.label: candidate
properties.description: The person attached to a candidature.

properties.label: contest
properties.description: The election contest attached to a candidature.

properties.label: appeared in election
properties.description: A party or label appeared in an election.

properties.label: register of interests record
properties.description: A register of interests record connected to a person.

properties.label: declared interest
properties.description: A register interest entry declared in a register record.

properties.label: interest category
properties.description: The source category of a register interest entry.

properties.label: source
properties.description: A source used as evidence for an entity or statement.

properties.label: source file
properties.description: A source file used by a map layer, source record, or generated dataset.

properties.label: download
properties.description: A downloadable file or resource exposed by a map layer or source record.

properties.label: provider
properties.description: A provider, publisher, or named source organisation.

properties.label: file format
properties.description: A source file or download format label.

properties.label: URL
properties.description: A URL for an entity, source, file, download, or interactive page.

properties.label: interactive URL
properties.description: A Civgraph interactive map or application URL.

properties.label: map category
properties.description: A map category or catalogue grouping label.

properties.label: feature in layer
properties.description: A feature group or feature belongs to a map layer.

properties.label: has feature
properties.description: A feature group contains a sampled or indexed feature.

properties.label: related election
properties.description: An election related to a feature group or geography entity.

properties.label: feature count
properties.description: Number of features in a feature group or source layer.

properties.label: bounding box
properties.description: A geographic bounding box represented as a comma-separated minX,minY,maxX,maxY value.

properties.label: spatial index
properties.description: A Civgraph spatial index URL for feature lookup.

properties.label: source kind
properties.description: A source class or extraction channel, such as NI Assembly PDF, NI Assembly HTML, NI Assembly API, or NI MP CSV.

properties.label: interest text
properties.description: The full extracted text for a register interest entry.

properties.label: nil return
properties.description: Whether the source record states that there are no interests to declare.

properties.label: candidature status
properties.description: The status of a person in an election result, such as elected or not elected.

properties.label: elected
properties.description: Whether the person was elected in an election result.

properties.label: first preference votes
properties.description: First preference or primary vote count where available in the source election data.

properties.label: votes
properties.description: Vote count where available in the source election data.

properties.label: seats
properties.description: Seat count where available in the source election data.

properties.label: stood
properties.description: Number of candidates who stood for a party or label in an election.

properties.label: vote share
properties.description: Percentage vote share where available in the source election data.

properties.label: source row count
properties.description: Number of source rows merged into or supporting a generated public record.

properties.label: extraction confidence
properties.description: Confidence label produced by an extraction pipeline.

properties.label: date
properties.description: A date associated with an entity or statement.

properties.label: year
properties.description: The calendar-year bucket an entity is dated within.

properties.label: constituency
properties.description: A constituency label attached to an election appearance or register record.

properties.label: jurisdiction
properties.description: A jurisdiction label attached to a body, person, or register record.

properties.label: History of Parliament biography
properties.description: The member's biography in the History of Parliament (History of Parliament Trust), linked and cited; its text is not reproduced.

properties.label: date of birth
properties.description: A person's date of birth, as precise as the cited source gives it.

properties.label: date of death
properties.description: A person's date of death, as precise as the cited source gives it.
